digest.component_or_area: plan-review and code-review gates, model resolution pipeline
propositions: Pass-1 ladder entries are BARE model ids (claude-haiku-4-5, claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-opus-4-8) that resolve to anthropic provider even when a non-anthropic provider is configured, causing split-brain in entry-rung assignment and escalation
MODEL_LADDER hardcodes bare Anthropic ids and models_at_or_above returns those bare names for escalation, so a Bedrock run silently escalates to direct Anthropic instead of staying on Bedrock
Ladder and escalation must be expressed as CLASS NAMES (trivial, standard, frontier) resolved through class config at runtime, making them provider-portable without schema changes or new keys

resolve_model (config.py:362), batch runners (production_batch_runner.py:93, code_review/batch_runner.py:55, workflow/runners.py:120), and models_at_or_above (sizing.py:312) must each wire through model_classes.resolve_model_string to resolve class names

MODEL_LADDER must remain unchanged (bare names + windows) and largest_window_tokens byte-for-byte unchanged; models_at_or_above maps rungs through class config after finding the start rung by substring match, preserving back-compat when no classes are configured
